label: Aquinas I q.13 a.7 bears on the LORD_1 bridge
note: Aquinas gives real subjection as the basis of divine lordship. The antecedent of CreatorOfAllIsLord quantifies over a generic cause of the being of every other actual bearer. It needs an account of why that causation entails real subjection with authority to dispose of the effects and why those bearers exhaust the relevant subjects.
